review_locator: PMCID:PMC4786634, Molecular mechanisms regulating NLRP3 inflammasome activation
primary_title: The DHX33 RNA helicase senses cytosolic RNA and activates the NLRP3 inflammasome
decision_basis: Primary evidence supports direct DHX33-NLRP3 domain-mapped association and dsRNA-dependent inflammasome activation
limitations_preserved: Preserve DEAD/NACHT domain mapping, dsRNA/bacterial-RNA stimulus specificity, human macrophage/reconstitution limits and no SCI/terminal-TF inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC4961213, IFN-induced Guanylate Binding Proteins in Inflammasome Activation and Host Defense
primary_title: GBP5 promotes NLRP3 inflammasome assembly and immunity in mammals
decision_basis: Primary evidence supports GBP5-NLRP3 association and stimulus-selective assembly promotion
limitations_preserved: Preserve GBP5 tetramerization/PYD-binding, selected soluble/bacterial stimulus subset, later universal-requirement uncertainty and no SCI/terminal-TF inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC8972007, TRIMs: Generalists Regulating the NLRP3 Inflammasome Signaling Pathway
primary_title: The E3 ubiquitin ligase tripartite motif 33 is essential for cytosolic RNA-induced NLRP3 inflammasome activation
decision_basis: Primary evidence supports direct K63-linked TRIM33 ubiquitination of DHX33 at K218 enabling the DHX33-NLRP3 complex
limitations_preserved: Preserve K218, K63 linkage, dsRNA dependence, human macrophage/HEK293T/purified-protein limits and no SCI/terminal-TF inference.
